notes: Phase 19E audits a normalized train-only corpus and freezes a trainer-neutral SFT candidate specification.
Cumulative records require target-only loss; validation/held-out rows cannot enter training.
Canonical Luna tool schema, privacy/context normalization, source derivation, duplicate checks, and conservative subset mixing are enforced.
Repository governance does not execute a GPU trainer and does not fabricate trained weights.
A trained candidate may be registered only from a matching successful external training receipt with content-addressed artifact evidence.
Every Phase 19E trained artifact remains unpromoted and has no runtime authority; Phase 19F owns improvement/promotion evaluation.
